name: ui-verify
description: Plans, runs and judges a UI verification (bug repro or feature check) on a named target environment: an Opus planner writes a staged, named plan the user approves, cheap executor agents run it stage by stage with a Playwright trace each, the controller checks the account after every switch, and the run ends with facts, a verdict, packed traces and trimmed videos. Project specifics (targets, accounts, UI catalog, domain rules) stay in the project.
